title: Hi, I'm David!
introText: I'm an Information Systems and Data Analyst and IT Administrator with a Master's degree in Computer Science and 9+ years across academic ERP systems, reporting workflows, and infrastructure. Recently I've shipped production full-stack features on a multi-tenant Next.js/PostgreSQL platform and evaluated training-data quality for AI models.
